bio: Afternoon Tea Awards 2024 - Award of Excellence  When The Langham, London opened in 1865 it started a new tradition; serving Afternoon Tea in an elegant Palm Court. The birthplace of Afternoon Tea continues to offer an award-winning experience for guests to enjoy.  Featherlight scones, the freshest savouries and patisserie using the finest British ingredients, that's the experience at Palm Court. Add to that a hot course for High Tea, or Champagne for extra indulgence, and you have a recipe for the very best memories.  Palm Court offers an extensive range of white, green and black teas all sourced by JING Tea; why not let their tea sommelier advise you and try something new? The Langham London have also created a tea pairing menu, that matches a particular tea to each course in Afternoon Tea.  Palm Court welcomes tea takers of all ages and provides a charming offering for children aged 12 and under.  Set in the heart of the Capital, The Langham, London is just a 5-minute stroll from Oxford Circus Underground Station.
